verified_tool_surface_semantics.supersedes_rule: every attempted with-tool cell must carry observed_mcp_tool_surface_hash == declared hash (all-cells-verified)
verified_tool_surface_semantics.new_rule: verified_tool_surface passes iff ALL of: (a) cells_total > 0 AND cells_total == the number of attempted with-tool (arm B) cells; (b) surface verification rate (cells_with_mcp_surface_verified / cells_total) >= minimum_surface_verification_rate (0.9), where a verified cell is a with-tool attempted cell carrying an observed hash obtained from status/status-retry evidence; (c) observed_mcp_tool_surface_consistent == true; (d) exactly one distinct observed hash across the arm and it equals the cohort's declared mcp_tool_surface_hash; (e) zero cells carry a DIFFERENT observed hash (and the declared cohort hash is present).
verified_tool_surface_semantics.gate_observed_shape: when this rate threshold is present the verified_tool_surface gate reports observed = {"rate": cells_with_mcp_surface_verified/cells_total, "verified": cells_with_mcp_surface_verified, "total": cells_total} and threshold = minimum_surface_verification_rate, so the rate is visible in the verdict.
verified_tool_surface_semantics.missing_hash: a with-tool cell with no observed hash after Track-1 retry + fallback is a CAPTURE MISS, not a violation — it lowers the verification rate (bounded by 1 - 0.9 = 10%) but does not fail the gate on its own.
verified_tool_surface_semantics.different_hash: a with-tool cell whose observed hash DIFFERS from the declared hash stays FATAL — this is a genuine surface mismatch, never a capture miss, and any single occurrence fails the gate regardless of rate.
verified_tool_surface_semantics.evidence: residual measured flake after Track 1 is the trigger; the 2026-07-21 Track-1 acceptance smoke measured 55/60 verified B-cells (8.3% irreducible, zero status-retry rescues), so the residual is real. See tempdoc 755 §A/§B/§F and the 2026-07-18 confirmatory VERDICT record.
